editorial:
Imagine being the only human in a school full of actual monsters. That is exactly the mess 12-year-old Mia finds herself in when she gets sent to Rotwood Academy. Along with her funny, scruffy rat named Quentin, Mia has to pretend she is a creature of the night just to survive the school day. The vibe is a perfect mix of spooky and silly, making you feel the tension every time a teacher walks by. You will quickly root for Mia as she tries to fit in while dealing with a vice principal who seems to smell a human in the building.

What really makes this movie work is the fast pace and the colorful animation that brings the monster world to life. The relationship between Mia and Quentin provides some of the best laughs, though some of the side characters feel a bit rushed.
endingExplained: In the final act, Vice Principal Van Vlad reveals he knew Mia was human all along. He tries to expel her using a magic spell, but Mia and her monster friends team up to stop him. The big twist is that Van Vlad was actually a human who used a potion to become a monster years ago. Mia manages to break the spell, turning him back into a normal person and saving the school from his mean rules.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical schools and funny pets.
